description: Log a change the user made to their website themselves (e.g. 'added internal links to /blog/x', 'new images in the guide') on the history timeline. Traffalyzer then measures its effect automatically: 28 days before vs. 28 days after, adjusted for the rest of the site. Backdating is allowed up to 16 months; old enough entries are measured right away. Free domains can have 3 active measures. Never call this without an explicit user request.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today. Not in the future.

domainId.description: Domain id of one of the user's projects, as returned by list_domains.

pages.description: Affected paths; omit for the whole site.

title.description: What was done, short, in the user's language.

name: log_measure
title: Log measure
